name: missing_vs_present
description: Binary ASNE contrast for an expected item being found versus not found.

object_present.text: A person opens the cabinet and sees the labeled folder inside the top drawer.
Someone checks the hook by the door and sees the spare key hanging there.
A person returns to the table and sees the sealed envelope beside the lamp.
Someone opens the case and sees the camera lens resting in the foam slot.
A person enters the studio and sees the violin stand beside the chair.

object_missing.text: A person opens the cabinet and sees the top drawer without the labeled folder.
Someone checks the hook by the door and sees no spare key hanging there.
A person returns to the table and sees no sealed envelope beside the lamp.
Someone opens the case and sees the foam slot without the camera lens.
A person enters the studio and sees the chair beside an empty violin stand.
